title: A flaw in Node.js Permission Model filesystem enforcement leaves `fs.realpathSync()` without the required read…
description: A security flaw exists in the Node.js permission model related to filesystem enforcement, specifically affecting the fs.realpathSync() function, which does not require the necessary read permissions. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-106073 and affects Microsoft product version 3.0. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
